text: also will you please add some twigs to the menu for props when hot reloads hit its annoying have it reset
resolution: The iso build rail's menus are twig state now: the active piece tab (floor/wall/.../prop) and the prop category shelf both persist as route twigs, so a hot reload restores the menu exactly where it was instead of snapping back to 'wall'. The ObjectsTab palette was already twigged from an earlier sweep (TWIGSWEEP-0610); the CatalogRail in the iso pane was the remaining useState holdout.
